network_status.network: Analisi agrometeorologica e climatologica della Sardegna 2008-2009
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPAS documenta l'eccezionale episodio della Baronia del 27-28 novembre 2008, incluso il massimo pluviometrico di Orosei, ma non pubblica livelli o portate del Rio Sa Minda. La pioggia non viene trasformata in una misura idrometrica del ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAS report documents the exceptional 27-28 November 2008 Baronia episode, including the Orosei rainfall maximum, but publishes no Rio Sa Minda stage or discharge. Rainfall is not converted into a hydrometric bridge measurement.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
